pages.title: Scorched land
pages.text: Basalt, blackstone and obsidian fields, lava lakes, a copper-dark sky and ash always in the air.

pages.title: What lives here
pages.text: $(li)$(l:heatland/volcano)Titanic Volcano$(/l): the heart of the land;$(li)$(l:heatland/klunnyk)Klunnyk$(/l): the old man by the lava lakes;$(li)$(l:heatland/bahatko)Bahatko$(/l): small fireballs;$(li)$(l:heatland/phoenix)Phoenix$(/l): ruler of the sky.$(br2)Fire is neither enemy nor friend here. It is the master, and you must learn its ways.
